intro: Lesson 34. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ (٩) وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ (١٠) كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ (١١) يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ (١٢)

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Infitar 82:9-12 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 82:9-12 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 82:9-12 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: What do we call the two angels who record our deeds?
questions.a: The noble recorders (kiraman katibin), as 82:11 describes them.
A) know whatever you do. 82:12: 'They know whatever you do.'

questions.q: Al-Infitar 82:10: «وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Two noble angels record everything we do (82:10 to 12). If you could see your record today, what would you want it to show?
questions.a: Prayers, kind words, honesty and helping others; it is never too late to add good deeds.
